parse_html_table_to_csv: parse an HTML wikitable from raw HTML and dump the cleaned rows to a CSV file
extract_wikitable_from_html: extract all wikitable elements from raw HTML and return a list of HtmlTable objects
normalize_html_table: normalize an HTML table by fixing colspan and rowspan attributes in place
clean_table_rows: clean table rows by removing empty rows, merging similar columns, and merging header rows
annotate_table_schema: annotate a table schema by inferring column types from sampled cell values using an NLP model
